sections.title: A family name *on the sign*
body: Carpenter's Tire & Auto has served North Augusta since 1977, and three generations of one family have owned it.
Ken Carpenter, the owner and namesake, moved the shop across Georgia Avenue for a larger space. In 2025 the North Augusta Chamber of Commerce named Carpenter's its Micro-Business of the Year.

items.a: 429 Georgia Avenue in North Augusta, SC 29841.
Call (803) 279-5469 and the shop will tell you when they can look at your car.
The Carpenter family, owners for three generations. Kenneth and Frank Carpenter run the shop today.
